name: Eye of Duskmantle
oracle_text:
Flying, lifelink
You may play lands and cast spells from among cards in your graveyard you've surveilled this turn. If you cast a spell this way, you pay life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: You may play lands and cast spells from among cards in your graveyard you've surveilled this turn. If you cast a spell this way, you pay life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.

needs.what: a per-turn record of which cards the controller put into their graveyard by surveilling this turn, readable as a selector/static filter key (e.g. surveilled_this_turn: "you") over graveyard cards
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The selector and static filter vocabularies have drawn_this_turn and entered_this_turn but nothing marking a card as surveilled into the graveyard this turn; the surveil op records no such provenance, so a cast_from_graveyard / play_lands_from_graveyard static cannot be narrowed to those cards

needs.what: a continuous permission (static, while this permanent is on the battlefield) to play lands and cast spells from your graveyard among a filtered set of cards, where spells cast this way are paid for with life equal to their mana value instead of their mana cost
needs.why_existing_wont_do: playable_pay_life_instead exists only on one-shot ops (exile, look_at_top, grant_playable) over cards an effect touched; the cast_from_graveyard static is the card's own permission for itself (permanent cards only) and carries no pay-life alternative, and play_lands_from_graveyard does not cover spells
